definitions.meaningfulFailureRate: successful edges from solvable states whose child is unsolvable / all successful edges from solvable states
definitions.meaningfulSolutionStrategies: winning sequences after unioning adjacent swaps that commute to the identical intermediate production state
definitions.polarityStrategicImpact: flip changes the immediately successful/viable action set or root solvability versus the same post-removal state without the flip
definitions.greedy: first immediately successful arrow in stable ID order; no solver look-ahead
definitions.randomVisible: random remaining taps without replacement until a successful tap; failed taps preserve state
